tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: The APIs the compendium covers: each with the hosts its trials hit, trust tier, version count, and counts of verified claims and spec divergences.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: The spec versions recorded for one API, newest first, each fingerprinted by its spec hash. The ids identify versions for get_version_diff.

tools.name: get_tool_knowledge
tools.description: Every verified claim about an API as structured records (latest version by default): paginated, filterable by kind, spec divergences flagged, each with compact evidence (trial id, probe, status, request line). verbose=true adds response previews.

tools.name: get_divergences
tools.description: Where the live API contradicts its own OpenAPI spec: documented limits not enforced, types not validated, required parameters not required, enums accepting other values. Compact evidence; verbose=true adds response previews.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Full-text search over verified claims by host and symptom, e.g. "github per_page 500", "npm search size 0", "is latitude required on /v1/forecast": the lookup for an unexpected 4xx/5xx, a parameter that seems ignored, an odd page, or wrong filter results. tools.name: get_tool_docs
tools.description: The verified behavior sheet for an API: Markdown built only from verified claims, with spec contradictions first, then sibling differences, undocumented rules, and per-endpoint behavior (error shapes, pagination, validation, auth), every line citing trial ids. tools.name: get_version_diff
tools.description: What changed in verified behavior between two spec versions of an API (changed, added and removed claims), as opposed to what changed in the spec text.

tools.name: request_target
tools.description: Queues a public, read-only, credential-free API for probing, from a target object { name, spec_url (OpenAPI 3 document), category?, include_paths?, baseline? (valid values for required params per path), optional_values?, server? }. The spec is fetched and parsed and the battery planned immediately;

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Status of a target request (pending, running, done or failed), with the run id and summary once processed.
